description: Change a live publication's title, impact, components or audience. To tell customers something new, post an update instead (anyforge_post_status_page_update). Titles and messages are what customers read: no internal names, repositories, people or other customers. Text the disclosure check stops is refused with disclosure_hits_remaining and the hits; reword it. Acts as you, with the same checks as the Console; a service account's key is refused. Requires `write` scope.

accountIds.description: Customer account ids; required with audience accounts.

audience.description: public: the public page and every customer link. accounts: only the links of accountIds.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

ifRevision.description: The revision you read. A stale one is refused (publication_modified / maintenance_modified); read again and retry.

title.description: One line customers read (at most 120 characters). Not the internal title or cause.

name: anyforge_update_status_page_publication
title: Update status page publication
